mapper.select: select u.id, u.unit_code as customer_no, u.unit_name as customer_name, u.address, CAST(u.status AS CHAR) as status from psi_unit u where u.deleted = 0 and u.unit_type in ('CUSTOMER', 'BOTH') and u.unit_code = #{customerNo} limit 1
select exists(select 1 from psi_unit where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and deleted=0 and unit_name=#{customerName})

select cast(a.id as char) as id, a.unit_name as name, a.unit_code as code, a.address, c.contact_name as contactName, coalesce(nullif(c.mobile,''), c.phone) as contactPhone from psi_unit a left join psi_unit_contact c on c.id=(select cc.id from psi_unit_contact cc where cc.unit_id=a.id and cc.tenant_id=a.tenant_id and cc.deleted=0 order by cc.is_default desc, cc.id limit 1) where a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and a.deleted=0 and a.status=1 and a.unit_type in ('CUSTOMER','BOTH') and a.id=#{customerId} and (locate(#{customerName}, a.unit_name)>0 or locate(#{customerName}, a.unit_code)>0)
or exists (select 1 from eoms_repair_order h where h.tenant_id=a.tenant_id and h.customer_id=a.id and h.engineer_id=#{params.dsUserId} and h.del_flag='0')
order by a.unit_name, a.id limit 25
